Definition: properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before
BiblicalUsage: ṭerem is the word the Bible uses when it means not yet, before. In Genesis 2:5, every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and it appears again in Exodus 1:19.
TheologicalSignificance: Before a single plant had sprouted, God was already at work, and that tells me His plans never wait on what I can see.
